name: traimer
description: trAIMer — Train. Measure. Tune. Aim measurement and sensitivity optimization engine (headless core), with a versioned game-profile layer that converts a measured physical sensitivity into per-game settings.

scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron .
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron . --smoke-test
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/verify-branding.mjs && node scripts/verify-branding.mjs --bundle dist-app && node scripts/verify-windows-artifacts.mjs --helper native/windows/traimer_capture_helper.exe && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never

author: trAIMer
